name: Knowledge
notes: Recall (the Brain) and plugin knowledge tabs; top-level features only

features.feature: Knowledge shows in the activity bar only with Recall on or a plugin's tab; otherwise `#brain` opens Calls
Settings → Knowledge → Use Recall turns the index on or off; its card shows what it holds, the last sync, Sync now, Keep it current, the embedding server, model, key and the page reader
Recall's Sources, Dictionary and People tabs browse what was indexed, by client or thread
Who may speak into Recall through mail and channels is decided per client (Trust, Ignore, Read anyway, Keep out)
Claude sessions get Recall as a read-only MCP server scoped to their AI profile
Plugins add tabs and settings rows to Knowledge (e.g. Obsidian vaults)
